page.title: Photo manager
page.description: Your photos for the listings and the pictures customers see on the platforms

info.title: About photos
info.body: «Library» — your photos, logos and covers; they go to the listings on sync. «On platforms» — everything the platforms show, including customer photos (UGC): inappropriate ones can be reported.

library.empty: No photos in the library yet
library.emptyHint: Upload photos, a logo and a cover — they will appear on the listings of every platform
library.deleteConfirm: Delete the photo from the library? It will be removed from the listings on the next sync.

listings.empty: No photos found on the platforms
listings.emptyHint: Change the filters or wait for the next scan
listings.deleteConfirm: Request removal of the photo from the platform?

upload.title: Upload photos
upload.description: JPG or PNG up to 8 MB, up to 10 files at once
upload.done: {count, plural, one {Photo uploaded} other {# photos uploaded}}

flag.title: Report a photo
flag.description: The platform reviews the report and hides the photo if it agrees
flag.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. the photo is not of our store
